title: Area Manager (ICQA)
searchText: Area Manager (ICQA) Flexport About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity: We are currently seeking individuals for a full-time position in our inaugural fulfillment centers, with a focus on ICQA (Inventory Control and Quality Assurance). As an ICQA and Continuous Improvement Manager, you will play a crucial role in launching and operating our fulfillment centers by ensuring efficient inventory management, maintaining high quality standards, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. As a key member of the Flexport team, you will serve as a people leader, responsible for managing a team on the operating floor. Your main objective will be to optimize the ICQA process, utilizing advanced tools, methodologies, and data analytics to ensure accurate inventory tracking, timely inspections, and quality control. You will also drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. This senior ICQA and Continuous Improvement Manager position offers a unique opportunity to invest in others and foster a collaborative leadership style. By leveraging the tools, processes, and operations that drive Flexport's mission to make global trade easy for everyone, you will contribute to the overall success of the company and shape the future of logistics with a focus on ICQA and continuous improvement. We are actively seeking high-potential candidates who are eager to embrace the challenge of ICQA management, drive process improvements, and contribute to our dynamic and innovative organization. Join us in our mission to revolutionize global trade and make a lasting impact on the industry through effective inventory control, quality assurance practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. Responsibilities: ICQA Operations and Quality Assurance: Support safety programs and compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates. Coordinate inventory control maintenance and random counts in accordance with network count strategies, ensuring compliance and consistency with SOX regulations. Measure quality, inventory integrity, and accuracy while providing proactive feedback to the operations management team. Review and analyze customer complaints and defect data, followed by developing action plans to reduce future incidents. Plan for and identify root causes of inventory deviation through cause and effect analysis. Participate in and lead network-wide fulfillment and operations-focused quality initiatives. Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and implement Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality. Lead and manage cross-functional continuous improvement projects, collaborating with various department managers. Analyze data, key performance indicators (KPIs), and process metrics to identify areas for improvement and optimize operational performance. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices to ensure consistent and efficient ICQA processes. Actively contribute to the development and implementation of technology solutions to improve inventory control and quality assurance. Team Management and Development: Lead and manage a team of area managers and hourly associates in ICQA operations within the fulfillment center. Drive team performance, employee development, and engagement. Motivate and mentor team members What you will need: Demonstrated solid proficiency in time management skills, alongside confidence in organizing vast amounts of data Proven ability to influence, with varying levels of seniority within an organization You’re highly dependable and able to manage business functions that can operate 24/7 (including holidays): you manage time efficiently to get the job done, A resilient, focused problem solver and self-starter, with the ability to multitask and prioritize in a complex and occasionally ambiguous environment Strong commitment to employee development, as well as an exceptional level of dedication, motivation and intelligence Previous supervisory experience in a distribution or manufacturing environment Excellent verbal and written communications skills in the local language and in English What we’re looking for: Degree in a science or logistics-based discipline, with a strong bias towards analytics and data would be advantageous Strong understanding of finance and accounting functions, with a grasp of how inventory and accounts relate to each other Background in a logistics, distribution or similar environment Previous Inventory Control and Quality Assurance Management experience Experience with Lean and Six Sigma methodologies and techniques Bonus points for: Experience working with SQL, creating and running reports. #LI-onsite The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the posting's respective region. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. The US base salary range for this position (this does not include bonus, equity and benefits): $64,800 — $81,000 USD Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
